product.description: The VigorFlex Elastic Band Set offers a versatile, compact solution for strength training and rehabilitation. Three bands with graduated resistance levels (light, medium, heavy) enable progressive workouts for beginners and advanced athletes alike. Each band measures 2.0 meters in length and is constructed from reinforced natural rubber and a durable polyester sleeve, ensuring long‑lasting performance. The set includes a convenient carrying pouch and a quick‑release handle for easy grip adjustments. Ideal for home routines, travel sessions, or professional conditioning, this kit delivers consistent tension and ergonomic comfort for a full‑body workout.
